paperTitleZh: 物理 全新模擬卷 — 卷二 選修 C 能量和能源的使用（結構題）

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh:
某運輸公司比較一輛電動巴士和一輛柴油巴士，資料如下：
電動巴士：電池容量 $300\ \text{kWh}$；滿電可行駛 $250\ \text{km}$；電動機最大輸出功率 $200\ \text{kW}$；滿載質量 $14000\ \text{kg}$
柴油巴士：耗油量 $35\ \text{L}$（每 $100\ \text{km}$）；柴油的能量含量 $36\ \text{MJ L}^{-1}$；滿載質量 $13000\ \text{kg}$
寫出在市區使用電動巴士代替柴油巴士的一個環境好處。
parts.questionTextEn:
A transport company compares an electric bus and a diesel bus. The data are as follows:
Electric bus: battery capacity $300\ \text{kWh}$; range on a full charge $250\ \text{km}$; maximum motor output power $200\ \text{kW}$; fully loaded mass $14000\ \text{kg}$
Diesel bus: fuel consumption $35\ \text{L}$ per $100\ \text{km}$; energy content of diesel $36\ \text{MJ L}^{-1}$; fully loaded mass $13000\ \text{kg}$
State one environmental advantage of using electric buses instead of diesel buses in a city.

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 求電動巴士每行駛 $1\ \text{km}$ 所消耗的電池能量，以 MJ 表示。
parts.questionTextEn: Find the battery energy used by the electric bus per km travelled, in MJ.

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 求柴油巴士每行駛 $1\ \text{km}$ 所消耗的燃料能量。
parts.questionTextEn: Find the fuel energy used by the diesel bus per km travelled.

parts.label: c(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 估算這段時間內巴士所得的平均有用輸出功率。（不計阻力）
parts.questionTextEn: Estimate the average useful output power of the bus during this time. (Neglect resistive forces.)

parts.label: c(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 由電池至車輪的效率為 $85\%$。假設加速期間電動機的輸出功率保持不變，求電池在這段時間的平均輸出功率，並判斷電動機能否應付。
parts.questionTextEn: The battery-to-wheel efficiency is $85\%$. Assuming the output power of the motor is constant during the acceleration, find the average power delivered by the battery during this time, and determine whether the motor can cope.

parts.label: d
parts.questionTextZh: 為電池充電的電力由效率為 $40\%$ 的發電廠產生（不計輸電及充電損耗）。有人說：「電動巴士只是把燃料消耗由路面轉到發電廠，所消耗的一次能源並沒有減少。」根據 (b) 的結果評論這個說法。
parts.questionTextEn: The electricity used to charge the battery is generated in a power station of efficiency $40\%$ (neglect transmission and charging losses). Someone says, "Electric buses only move fuel use from the road to the power station; they do not reduce the primary energy used." Comment on this statement using the results of (b).
